These cells have large, vesicular nuclei, prominent eosinophilic nucleoli, and abundant cytoplasm."}, {"bbox": [74, 1113, 1342, 1156], "category": "Text", "text": "**Immunohistochemistry:** The large, atypical cells show the following immunophenotype:"}, {"bbox": [74, 1153, 286, 1184], "category": "Text", "text": "- CD30: Positive"}, {"bbox": [74, 1192, 286, 1223], "category": "Text", "text": "- CD15: Positive"}, {"bbox": [74, 1232, 360, 1268], "category": "Text", "text": "- PAX5: Positive (dim)"}, {"bbox": [74, 1273, 298, 1308], "category": "Text", "text": "- CD45: Negative"}, {"bbox": [74, 1313, 298, 1349], "category": "Text", "text": "- CD20: Negative"}, {"bbox": [74, 1354, 782, 1392], "category": "Text", "text": "- CD3: Highlights the background T-cell population."}, {"bbox": [69, 1394, 1481, 1515], "category": "Text", "text": "**Comment:** The morphologic findings in conjunction with the immunophenotype (CD30+, CD15+, PAX5+, CD45-) are diagnostic of Classical Hodgkin Lymphoma, Nodular Sclerosis subtype. Clinical correlation and appropriate oncologic management are recommended."}, {"bbox": [67, 1516, 512, 1585], "category": "Text", "text": "**Specimen:** Left cervical lymph node"}, {"bbox": [1065, 1525, 1524, 1562], "category": "Text", "text": "**Pathologist:** Dr. Benjamin Ayers"}, {"bbox": [67, 1597, 360, 1633], "category": "Text", "text": "**Report status:** Final"}, {"bbox": [46, 1998, 437, 2033], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "Accession #: SH-25-55443"}, {"bbox": [1392, 2048, 1545, 2083], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "Page 1 of 1"}]

REM sleep was reduced, comprising only 10% of total sleep time."}, {"bbox": [141, 1024, 1604, 1315], "category": "Text", "text": "Frequent respiratory events were noted throughout the night. The patient's baseline oxygen saturation was 95%. No significant periodic limb movements were noted."}, {"bbox": [394, 863, 1584, 973], "category": "Text", "text": "Impression: The findings are consistent with severe obstructive sleep apnea (OSA)."}, {"bbox": [174, 630, 1573, 831], "category": "Text", "text": "A follow-up appointment is recommended to discuss treatment options, including positive airway pressure (PAP) therapy.
